about: The places tools/look-bench.mjs pictures, a list a game. ready: true once the game can be driven; prelude: run once it is (a player, the screen quiet); quiet: run just before each picture (an arrival's banner cleared); stats: what to say under each picture; each place: its set (--sets), the run that stands there (facing as a player arrives), then settle (ms) for what streams in and the light and air to settle.

wyrd.prelude: if (!WY.D || !WY.D.made || WY.D.name === 'Wren') WY.begin(); WY.menu.hide(); WY.G.say = ''; WY.G.sayT = 0; WY.G.toasts.length = 0;

places.name: Hearthrim: the well and the riftgate
Hearthrim: the houses to the west
The Briarholt's camp
places.run: const p = (WY.W.feats || WY.W.nodes).find(n => n.kind === 'portal' && n.reg === 1); WY.goto(p.x + 1, p.z - 2); WY.H.yaw = Math.PI; WY.sim(0.3);

places.name: The Briarholt's open country
places.run: const a = -Math.PI + (1 - 0.5) * Math.PI * 2 / 5 + 0.628 + 0.12; WY.goto(Math.cos(a) * 170, Math.sin(a) * 170); WY.H.yaw = Math.PI; WY.sim(0.3);
